activity.role: King of England and Angevin ruler
activity.notes: Henry II's accession to the English throne in 1154 consolidated the cross-Channel Plantagenet dominions often called the 'Angevin Empire' by modern historians. The term was not a contemporary formal state title, so ATLAS uses it as a historiographical polity label for his composite dominions through his death in 1189.

sources.title: Henry II — king of England
sources.citation_text: Britannica identifies Henry II as king of England from 1154 to 1189 and describes his extensive continental dominions.
